Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module's five main topic areas — CSS basics, selectors, the box model, typography and colors, and layout techniques including Flexbox — that learners use to preview what will be covered and instructors use to verify curricular scope.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: This outline lists and summarises all topics covered in the module — Introduction to CSS, selectors, the box model, typography, colors, layout techniques, and a capstone styling project — giving learners and instructors a navigable overview of what the module contains.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to CSS
Artifacts.Description: This reading introduces CSS as a stylesheet language, explains how it separates visual presentation from HTML structure, and covers how to apply styles using inline, internal, and external methods, serving as a learner's first conceptual foundation for the module.

Artifacts.Name: CSS Selectors
Artifacts.Description: This reading explains CSS selectors — including type, class, ID, attribute, and pseudo-class selectors — and how specificity determines which rules win when multiple rules conflict, helping learners precisely target HTML elements for styling.

Artifacts.Name: The Box Model
Artifacts.Description: This reading covers the CSS Box Model, explaining how every HTML element is rendered as a rectangular box composed of content, padding, border, and margin, so learners can accurately control spacing, sizing, and layout behaviour.

Artifacts.Name: Typography and Colors
Artifacts.Description: This reading covers CSS typography properties (font family, size, weight, line height, spacing) and color tools (named colors, hex, RGB, HSL, and background colors), enabling learners to style text and establish a visual hierarchy on web pages.

Artifacts.Name: CSS Layout Techniques
Artifacts.Description: This reading covers CSS layout techniques including normal flow, the display property, Flexbox, and CSS Grid, teaching learners how to arrange and align page elements beyond the browser's default document flow.

Artifacts.Name: Styling a Complete Web Page
Artifacts.Description: This reading guides learners through combining selectors, the box model, typography, color, and pseudo-classes into a cohesive stylesheet for a complete, multi-section web page, serving as an integrative capstone lesson for the module.
